notes: FIXED: after buying SECOND WIND or MUNCHIES (the joint perks) you could not buy any other perk for the rest of the game - the joint's smoke trail never stopped, so the game thought you were still smoking. Every perk can be bought now, with its own animation: the bowl for DOUBLE DAB and QUICK RIP, the edible for ZOOMIES and KUSH TANK, the joint for SECOND WIND and MUNCHIES.

ZOMBIES SPAWN NEAR YOU: they only come from the parts of the map you have opened, about 12 to 28 m away by the walking route, and out of sight when possible (they used to come from anywhere up to 60 m away).

FAR ZOMBIES COME BACK: a zombie that ends up far away or cut off for a few seconds disappears and comes in again near you, keeping its health - no more hunting for the last straggler, and less for the game to run. The bosses too.
FEWER LINES AT THE START: the story's opening scene now plays only the first time you play each map, and the chapter 1 briefing waits until round 1 is over.
NEW VOICE LINES: all four survivors have a new, more adult set of everyday lines, and they talk about getting high a lot more. The story scenes are unchanged.
